Alright, here is what the options look like for December 18–20, capped at $300 a night.

---

### 🌊 Coastal drive — Seacliff House, Bellhaven

**$289/night standard room** ($578 total for two nights)
Two hours from Glenmont on the coast road. Sea-facing terrace, restaurant on site, parking included. The standard room fits under your cap; the ocean view ($366) and suite ($452) go over it. Two-night minimum applies on weekends, so that is already covered.

**Tradeoff:** You get the scenic drive and the coastal weekend feel, but the standard room is the only choice that stays in budget — and at $289 it is right up against your cap.

---

### 🏔️ Valley — two options

**Cedar Hollow Lodge** — **$142/night standard** ($284 total)
Breakfast included, wifi, shuttle. It is described as three minutes from the winter camp hall, forty minutes from Kessler Falls Regional. Well under budget, money left for dinner out.

**Alder Vale Inn, Bitterfield** — **$128/night standard** or **$146/night double** ($256–$292 total)
An hour out on the valley road. Breakfast included, parking. Quiet. Also well under budget.

---

### How they compare

| | Seacliff House (coastal) | Cedar Hollow Lodge (valley) | Alder Vale Inn (valley) |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Nightly rate** | $289 | $142 | $128–$146 |
| **Two-night total** | $578 | $284 | $256–$292 |
| **Drive from Glenmont** | ~2 hrs, coast road | ~40 min–1 hr | ~1 hr, valley road |
| **Vibe** | Sea terrace, restaurant, scenic drive | Lodge, breakfast in, budget-friendly | Quiet, plain, nothing to distract |
| **Room under $300?** | Standard only | Yes, plenty of headroom | Yes, plenty of headroom |

---

**My read:** If the weekend is about the drive and the coastal atmosphere, Seacliff House in a standard room is the clear pick — it is the only coastal option and it fits. If the priority is keeping costs down and having more freedom for meals and activities, either valley option leaves you $250+ under cap for the two nights to spend on dinner, drinks, or whatever you and Patricia decide to do.
